NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

DESIGN REVIEW (DR-2021-27) AND TENTATIVE TRACT MAP (TTM-83660) – The Planning Commission will consider a request for Design Review and Tentative Tract Map to allow for an eight-unit townhome development along the Azusa Avenue Corridor (CAZ) zone district. The Tentative Tract Map would merge two land parcels and allow the creation of eight air parcels over the newly created land lot for condominium purposes. The proposal includes the demolition of an existing single-family residence.

CODE AMENDMENT 251: ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS AND JUNIOR ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS; REPEAL DISRECTIONARY PERMITS FOR ADUS The Planning Commission will consider making a recommendation to the City Council regarding a proposed Amendment to Section 88.42.190 (Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units) of the Azusa Municipal Code, repealing Section 88.51.034 (Discretionary Permit for Accessory Dwelling Unit that Does Not Qualify for Ministerial Approval) of the Azusa Municipal Code in its entirety, and exemption of these actions from the California Environmental Quality Act. The proposed changes to Azusa’s ADU and JADU ordinance would provide consistency with State Law.
